goal: Output encoding review: data written into HTML, scripts, URLs, headers or logs is encoded for its context.
use: Output encoding review: data written into HTML, scripts, URLs, headers or logs is encoded for its context. Use when code writes user or stored data into a page, script or header.

steps.note: List the sinks. Find each place output is written to HTML, JavaScript, URLs, headers or logs.
Check context. Each sink needs the encoding for its context.
Flag raw writes. Flag innerHTML, unencoded templates and string-built headers.
Flag raw HTML from users. Flag rendering of user content without sanitising.
Report. Each sink with its context, the gap and the fix.
